title: ptyssiglottis debilis
intro: Ptyssiglottis debilis, commonly known as Malay cat's whiskers, is a plant species within the family Gesneriaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ptyssiglottis debilis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
